segments.2TI.1.3-5: Paul thanks God for Timothy’s sincere faith
segments.2TI.1.6-7: Paul urges Timothy to use God’s gift without fear
segments.2TI.1.8-11: Timothy must not be ashamed but suffer for the gospel
segments.2TI.1.12-12: Paul is not ashamed of suffering because he trusts God
segments.2TI.1.13-14: Timothy must hold to sound teaching and guard it
segments.2TI.1.15-18: Many left Paul, but Onesiphorus helped him often
segments.2TI.2.1-2: Timothy must be strong and train faithful men to teach
segments.2TI.2.8-10: Paul suffers in chains, but God’s word is not chained
segments.2TI.2.16-18: Timothy must avoid empty talk and false teachers
segments.2TI.2.19-21: Believers who clean themselves are useful to the Master
segments.2TI.2.22-23: Timothy must flee youthful passions and pursue peace
segments.2TI.2.24-26: The Lord’s servant must be kind and teach gently
segments.2TI.3.1-4: In the last days men will be selfish and evil
segments.2TI.3.5-7: Timothy must turn away from men who only seem godly
segments.2TI.3.8-9: False teachers oppose the truth like Jannes and Jambres
segments.2TI.3.10-13: The Lord rescued Paul; godly believers will be persecuted
segments.2TI.3.14-15: Timothy must continue in what he learned from Scripture
segments.2TI.3.16-17: Scripture is from God and equips believers for good work
segments.2TI.4.1-2: Paul charges Timothy to preach the word
segments.2TI.4.3-5: Men will reject truth, but Timothy must do his work
segments.2TI.4.6-8: Paul has kept the faith and expects a crown
segments.2TI.4.9-10: Paul asks Timothy to come quickly; Demas left Paul
segments.2TI.4.11-13: Paul asks Timothy to bring Mark, his cloak and scrolls
segments.2TI.4.14-15: Paul warns Timothy about Alexander, who harmed Paul
segments.2TI.4.16-16: No one stood with Paul at his first defense
segments.2TI.4.17-18: The Lord stood by Paul and will rescue him
